gaps.explanation: The budget schedules (pp12-16) are on the budgetary basis; the governmental funds statement (p5) is GAAP. The report's own reconciliation (p17, Note A 'Cash to accrual adjustments') prints the difference per fund: General Fund 26,435,368 + 107,940 = 26,543,308; Street 5,059,305 + 13,798 = 5,073,103; Museum 1,926,920 + (5,932) = 1,920,988; Debt Service 1,580,761 + (1,459) = 1,579,302. Other Governmental Funds 4,505,361 = nonmajor combining statement fund columns (pp18-21) 4,505,361, no difference. 107,940 + 13,798 - 5,932 - 1,459 = 114,347 = the gap. All printed schedule lines are in detail[]; nothing missing or duplicated. No fix.

Reconciliation p17 (Note A, cash to accrual adjustments on uses/outflows): General Fund 24,815,611 + (292,487) = 24,523,124; Street 4,313,458 + 208,004 = 4,521,462; Museum 1,890,703 + (11,742) = 1,878,961; Debt Service 465,826 + (1,045) = 464,781 (statement p5). Other Governmental Funds 10,041,850 = nonmajor combining statement (pp18-21) 10,041,850. -292,487 + 208,004 - 11,742 - 1,045 = -97,270 = the gap (schedule above statement). Basis difference printed by the report itself; no fix.
